name: rusty-engine-studio
description: First-party Rusty Engine authoring Studio workspace.

scripts.build: pnpm run build:renderer && pnpm --filter @rusty-engine/studio-user-settings run build && pnpm --filter @rusty-engine/studio-adapter-client run build && pnpm --filter @rusty-engine/studio-viewport run build && pnpm --filter @rusty-engine/studio-voxel-editor run build && pnpm --filter @rusty-engine/studio-editor-shell run build && NX_DAEMON=false nx build studio-app
scripts.lint: NX_DAEMON=false nx run-many -t lint --all && eslint scripts test
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run build:renderer && pnpm --filter @rusty-engine/studio-user-settings run typecheck && pnpm --filter @rusty-engine/studio-adapter-client run typecheck && pnpm --filter @rusty-engine/studio-viewport run typecheck && pnpm --filter @rusty-engine/studio-voxel-editor run typecheck && pnpm --filter @rusty-engine/studio-editor-shell run typecheck && NX_DAEMON=false nx run studio-app:typecheck && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.host.json
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @rusty-engine/studio-user-settings run test && pnpm --filter @rusty-engine/studio-adapter-client run test && pnpm --filter @rusty-engine/studio-viewport run test && pnpm --filter @rusty-engine/studio-voxel-editor run test && pnpm --filter @rusty-engine/studio-editor-shell run test && NX_DAEMON=false nx run studio-app:test && tsx --test test/studio-user-settings-service.test.ts test/studio-host-files-service.test.ts test/studio-render-resource-service.test.ts test/studio-adapter-process.test.ts test/studio-adapter-host.test.ts test/studio-host-identity.test.ts test/studio-service.test.ts
scripts.check: pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test
scripts.verify:adapter-client: pnpm --filter @rusty-engine/studio-adapter-client run typecheck && pnpm --filter @rusty-engine/studio-adapter-client run test
scripts.verify: pnpm run check:boundaries && pnpm run check:migration && pnpm run test:migration && pnpm run check && pnpm run build
